snp3.7:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā aṅguttarāpesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhateḷasehi bhikkhusatehi yena āpaṇaṃ nāma aṅguttarāpānaṃ nigamo tadavasari.
snp3.7:1.4: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito aṅguttarāpesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhateḷasehi bhikkhusatehi āpaṇaṃ anuppatto.
snp3.7:1.5: taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato
snp3.7:1.6: itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā
snp3.7:1.7: so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti
snp3.7:1.8: so dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti
snp3.7:1.9: sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotīti.
snp3.7:2.1: atha kho keṇiyo jaṭilo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
snp3.7:2.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
snp3.7:2.3: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho keṇiyaṃ jaṭilaṃ bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
snp3.7:2.4: atha kho keṇiyo jaṭilo bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
snp3.7:2.5: adhivāsetu me bhavaṃ gotamo svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenāti.
snp3.7:2.6: evaṃ vutte bhagavā keṇiyaṃ jaṭilaṃ etadavoca
snp3.7:2.7: mahā kho keṇiya bhikkhusaṅgho aḍḍhateḷasāni bhikkhusatāni tvañca brāhmaṇesu abhippasannoti.
snp3.7:3.1: dutiyampi kho keṇiyo jaṭilo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca

snp3.7:3.3: adhivāsetu me bhavaṃ gotamo svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenāti.
snp3.7:3.4: dutiyampi kho bhagavā keṇiyaṃ jaṭilaṃ etadavoca
snp3.7:3.5: mahā kho keṇiya bhikkhusaṅgho aḍḍhateḷasāni bhikkhusatāni tvañca brāhmaṇesu abhippasannoti.
snp3.7:4.1: tatiyampi kho keṇiyo jaṭilo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca

snp3.7:4.3: adhivāsetu me bhavaṃ gotamo svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenāti.
snp3.7:4.5: atha kho keṇiyo jaṭilo bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena sako assamo tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā mittāmacce ñātisālohite āmantesi
snp3.7:4.7: samaṇo me gotamo nimantito svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena

snp3.7:4.10: keṇiyo pana jaṭilo sāmaṃ yeva maṇḍalamālaṃ paṭiyādeti.
snp3.7:5.1: tena kho pana samayena selo brāhmaṇo āpaṇe paṭivasati tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ padako veyyākaraṇo lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo tīṇi ca māṇavakasatāni mante vāceti.
snp3.7:6.1: tena kho pana samayena keṇiyo jaṭilo sele brāhmaṇe abhippasanno hoti.
snp3.7:6.2: atha kho selo brāhmaṇo tīhi māṇavakasatehi parivuto jaṅghāvihāraṃ anucaṅkamamāno anuvicaramāno yena keṇiyassa jaṭilassa assamo tenupasaṅkami.
snp3.7:6.3: addasā kho selo brāhmaṇo keṇiyassa jaṭilassa assame appekacce uddhanāni khaṇante …pe… appekacce āsanāni paññāpente keṇiyaṃ pana jaṭilaṃ sāmaṃ yeva maṇḍalamālaṃ paṭiyādentaṃ
snp3.7:6.5: kiṃ nu kho bhoto keṇiyassa āvāho vā bhavissati vivāho vā bhavissati mahāyañño vā paccupaṭṭhito rājā vā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro nimantito svātanāya saddhiṃ balakāyenāti.
snp3.7:7.1: na me bho sela āvāho vā bhavissati napi vivāho bhavissati napi rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro nimantito svātanāya saddhiṃ balakāyena.
snp3.7:7.2: api ca kho me mahāyañño paccupaṭṭhito
snp3.7:7.3: atthi samaṇo gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito aṅguttarāpesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhateḷasehi bhikkhusatehi āpaṇaṃ anuppatto
snp3.7:7.4: taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato itipi so bhagavā …pe…
snp3.7:7.6: so me nimantito svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenāti.
snp3.7:8.2: ghosopi kho eso dullabho lokasmiṃ yadidaṃ buddhoti.
snp3.7:8.3: āgatāni kho pana asmākaṃ mantesu dvattiṃsa mahāpurisalakkhaṇāni yehi samannāgatassa mahāpurisassa dveva gatiyo bhavanti anaññā
snp3.7:8.4: sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati rājā hoti cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato
snp3.7:8.6: cakkaratanaṃ hatthiratanaṃ assaratanaṃ maṇiratanaṃ itthiratanaṃ gahapatiratanaṃ pariṇāyakaratanameva sattamaṃ.
snp3.7:8.7: parosahassaṃ kho panassa puttā bhavanti sūrā viraṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā.
snp3.7:8.8: so imaṃ paṭhaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati.
snp3.7:8.9: sace kho pana agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati arahaṃ hoti sammāsambuddho loke vivaṭacchado.
snp3.7:8.10: kahaṃ pana bho keṇiya etarahi so bhavaṃ gotamo viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddhoti.
snp3.7:9.1: evaṃ vutte keṇiyo jaṭilo dakkhiṇaṃ bāhaṃ paggahetvā selaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca
snp3.7:9.3: atha kho selo brāhmaṇo tīhi māṇavakasatehi saddhiṃ yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami.
snp3.7:9.4: atha kho selo brāhmaṇo te māṇavake āmantesi
snp3.7:9.5: appasaddā bhonto āgacchantu pade padaṃ nikkhipantā
snp3.7:9.6: durāsadā hi te bhavanto sīhāva ekacarā
snp3.7:9.7: yadā cāhaṃ bho samaṇena gotamena saddhiṃ manteyyaṃ mā me bhonto antarantarā kathaṃ opātetha
snp3.7:10.1: atha kho selo brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
snp3.7:10.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
snp3.7:10.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho selo brāhmaṇo bhagavato kāye dvattiṃsa mahāpurisalakkhaṇāni sammannesi.
snp3.7:10.4: addasā kho selo brāhmaṇo bhagavato kāye dvattiṃsa mahāpurisalakkhaṇāni yebhuyyena ṭhapetvā dve
snp3.7:10.5: dvīsu mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati
snp3.7:11.2: passati kho me ayaṃ selo brāhmaṇo dvattiṃsa mahāpurisalakkhaṇāni yebhuyyena ṭhapetvā dve
snp3.7:11.3: dvīsu mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati
snp3.7:11.5: atha kho bhagavā tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāresi yathā addasa selo brāhmaṇo bhagavato kosohitaṃ vatthaguyhaṃ.
snp3.7:11.6: atha kho bhagavā jivhaṃ ninnāmetvā ubhopi kaṇṇasotāni anumasi paṭimasi ubhopi nāsikasotāni anumasi paṭimasi kevalampi nalāṭamaṇḍalaṃ jivhāya chādesi.
snp3.7:12.2: samannāgato kho samaṇo gotamo dvattiṃsāya mahāpurisalakkhaṇehi paripuṇṇehi no aparipuṇṇehi
snp3.7:12.3: no ca kho naṃ jānāmi buddho vā no vā.
snp3.7:12.4: sutaṃ kho panetaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ vuḍḍhānaṃ mahallakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ
snp3.7:12.5: ye te bhagavanto arahanto sammāsambuddhā te sake vaṇṇe bhaññamāne attānaṃ pātukarontīti
snp3.7:12.6: yannūnāhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ sammukhā sāruppāhi gāthāhi abhitthaveyyanti.
snp3.7:12.7: atha kho selo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ sammukhā sāruppāhi gāthāhi abhitthavi
snp3.7:33.1: alattha kho selo brāhmaṇo sapariso bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ alattha upasampadaṃ.
snp3.7:33.2: atha kho keṇiyo jaṭilo tassā rattiyā accayena sake assame paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi
snp3.7:33.4: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena keṇiyassa jaṭilassa assamo tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena.
snp3.7:34.1: atha kho keṇiyo jaṭilo buddhappamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi.
snp3.7:34.2: atha kho keṇiyo jaṭilo bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ aññataraṃ nīcaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
snp3.7:34.3: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho keṇiyaṃ jaṭilaṃ bhagavā imāhi gāthāhi anumodi
snp3.7:37.1: atha kho bhagavā keṇiyaṃ jaṭilaṃ imāhi gāthāhi anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
snp3.7:37.2: atha kho āyasmā selo sapariso eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi.
snp3.7:37.3: aññataro kho panāyasmā selo sapariso arahataṃ ahosi.
snp3.7:38.1: atha kho āyasmā selo sapariso yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ cīvaraṃ katvā yena bhagavā tenañjalimpaṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi
